source_requirement: quote must match original unit; citation must exist in the packed snapshot
semantic_admission: JEV supported required for new accepted graph claims
legacy_claims: pending; verified original source can be retrieved, extracted assertion never self-authorizes an answer
answer_requirement: separate JEV call must support every atomic section and every evidence need
quarantine: visible in explorer; excluded from answer evidence
ontology: terminology and source-stated taxonomy only; no efficacy from aliases or co-indexing
duplicates: same namespace, source, statement, polarity, context and evidence content
conflicts: retain alternative source assertions, flag for validation; never infer contradiction from different objects alone
ocr: missing native text requires OCR review; no fabricated scan text
